supportedClaim: Source/provenance semantics for the currently admitted canonical Hero-Soldier relations.
claimScope: Defines only how retained ConfigData evidence supports the current Hero-Soldier canonical claims. It is not a source-population inventory, future completeness rule, or admission authority.

BASE_SOLDIER_HERO.interpretation: Each explicitly listed Hero ID supports a Hero-Soldier relation to that NORMAL Soldier.

SP_HERO_REWARD.interpretation: Each explicitly listed Soldier ID supports a Hero-Soldier relation for that Hero.
SP_HERO_REWARD.scope: Current claim-scoped SP Hero reward source rows only.

SP_SOLDIER_EXPAND.interpretation: Each explicitly listed Hero ID is an additive Hero-Soldier relation for that SP Soldier.

SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.nativeDirection: eligible NORMAL Hero-Soldier relation -> explicitly linked SP Soldier relation
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.interpretation: An SP Soldier inherits an eligible Hero-Soldier relation from its explicit NORMAL parent.
SP_SOLDIER_INHERIT.provenanceRule: The derived edge preserves the parent source kind and original source-record provenance and adds the explicit SP_FORM_LINK support relation.

SP_FORM_LINK.interpretation: Explicit NORMAL-to-SP Soldier form link used only to authorize SP inheritance.

limitations: Only the listed source kinds and support relation are interpreted for the current admitted claims.
No unlisted ConfigData field, inferred pattern, or endpoint expansion creates a new canonical relation.
This artifact does not define future relation completeness or admission.
